sources.harvard_location: TOZ GEN N.A.LING. K 913 la; FIG HathiTrust; WID Old Widener Arc 307.2 vol.9; TOZ Offsite Storage L.SOC.120.Cf.5 (9:3)
sources.note: Only accent statements are for Northern Sierra Miwok (p. 279: stress 'may be found on any syllable between the first and the last'; long vowels and vowels before glottal stop/geminate 'generally bear the accent') and the Southern Sierra plural accent shift (p. 296). The Coast (Marin/Bodega) dialect section pp. 292-320 has no word-stress statement; p. 305 only calls Coast pronominal elements 'accentless particles or proclitics'. Silent for coas1301.

sources.citation: Barrett, S. A. 1908. The geography and dialects of the Miwok Indians. UCPAAE 6(2): 333-368.
sources.note: Dialect geography and comparative vocabulary; no occurrence of 'accent' or 'stress'. Silent.

sources.citation: WALS Online: languoid table and features 14A Fixed Stress Locations, 15A Weight-Sensitive Stress, 16A Weight Factors (Goedemans & van der Hulst).
sources.note: WALS lists 'Miwok (Bodega)' = mkb = coas1301 but has NO value for it in 14A/15A/16A; only Central, Northern and Southern Sierra Miwok carry stress datapoints. Silent.
